text: Happy Friday everyone! Anyone got fun weekend plans? I’m thinking about finally taking Max (my dog) to that new park by the river.

Omg Sam, do it! I took Luna there last weekend and she went absolutely nuts chasing squirrels 😂 Also, I just saw this meme and it’s basically me after debugging all week: *[posts meme of a cat smashing a keyboard]*
LOL that’s too real. Speaking of bugs, did anyone else’s Slack randomly log them out this morning or was that just me?
Nope, happened to me too. I thought it was just my laptop being weird again. Maybe it’s a sign we should all just log off and go play with our pets instead 😅
Jumping in to say my cat just walked across my keyboard and sent a half-written email to my manager, so I’m voting yes on the pets-takeover plan 😂
